title: THE TRADE DIALECTIC
subtitle: How modern industrial policy emerged from a contradiction.
source: Rodrik, D. (2017). Straight Talk on Trade.

thesis.label: Free Trade
thesis.body: Comparative advantage makes everyone better off; protectionism is self-harm.

antithesis.label: Trade Harms
antithesis.body: Workers in displaced industries don't get compensated; aggregate gains mask localised devastation.

synthesis.label: Managed Trade
synthesis.body: Strategic protection of key sectors paired with adjustment assistance — the policy regime most industrial states actually adopt.
